declaration_order: Written before applying this contract to any cached response
primary_status: strict_v1 remains primary for all previously reported results; no original result or raw cache is replaced
grammar: One integer or finite decimal numeral, optionally followed by %. Leading/trailing whitespace allowed; no other text or internal whitespace, multiple numbers, signs, exponent notation, NaN or infinity.
units: With %: divide by 100. Without %: values in [0,1] are probabilities; values in (1,100] are percentages divided by 100. Thus bare 1 is 100% confidence, while 1% is 1% confidence.
grid: Exact Decimal equality against the declared numerical grid. No clipping, rounding or tolerance-based repair.
scope: Secondary cached-response interpretation is retrospective relative to original data collection. This declaration precedes applying lenient_v1, not the collection itself. Old optional_percent_v1 is a distinct percentage-units-only diagnostic.
